name: development-javascript
description: JavaScript/TypeScript maintenance plugin (foundation slice, #729). Receives findings from /development:maintenance, validates its JSON payload, and dispatches the format_lint group to js-format-lint-fixer (ESLint --fix + Prettier --write), with js-ci-fixer handling CI-failure remediation on the resulting PRs. Blessed toolchain installed by /development:bootstrap: flat eslint.config.js, Prettier @120, vitest + v8 coverage, a strict tsconfig base, npm, and Node 24 LTS. The contract-consumer machinery (orval typed client + MSW), the review panel, static-analysis triage, coverage, vendor PRs, and the approver land in later slices of #683.
